hero.title: Tripod is a creative studio turning ideas into visuals, motion, and campaign assets.
hero.subtitle: We work across branding, design, production, photography, music, print, and digital rollout with studio energy built for attention.

statement.title: One studio. Multiple disciplines. One direction.
